title: Splitting PDFs by page ranges: practical examples
excerpt: Use page ranges to create separate PDFs or one combined selection, and verify the page counts in each download.
author: The MY PDF FIX Team
body:
## Start with physical page positions

Before splitting, open the original and count pages using the viewer's page position. A document may display “iii” on its third page or begin printed numbering after a cover. PDF Fix Hub accepts physical positions beginning at 1, not printed labels or bookmark names.

Keep the original. Creating smaller PDFs is useful for sharing sections, but it is not a guarantee that hidden data has been sanitized or that document-wide features such as bookmarks and signatures remain unchanged.

## Example: turn six pages into two files

To divide a six-page PDF after page two:

1. Open [Split PDF](/split-pdf) and add the document.
2. Enter `1-2, 3-6` in **Page ranges**.
3. Click **Process**, then **Download**.
4. Extract the ZIP. You should find one PDF containing original pages 1–2 and another containing pages 3–6.
5. Open both files. Check their page counts — two and four — and compare the first and last page of each with the original.

These counts follow from the requested ranges; they are not a claim that your file has been tested. An image-heavy section can still be large even with fewer pages.

## One range, several single pages, or one combined selection?

One range, such as `2-4`, produces one three-page PDF. Multiple comma-separated parts produce separate PDFs bundled into a ZIP. To create individual files from a three-page original, enter `1, 2, 3`. There is no separate one-click “every page” control.

If you want original pages 1, 2 and 5 together in one PDF, use [Extract Pages](/extract-pdf-pages) with `1-2, 5`. The same comma-separated input in Split instead requests two output files. Choose the tool according to the output you need.

## What is not supported

The current Split interface does not split automatically at bookmarks, into equal chunks or to a target megabyte size. For known chapter boundaries, enter the chapter ranges yourself. For a file-size limit, inspect the resulting files and adjust the ranges; fewer pages do not guarantee a particular size.

[Compress PDF](/compress-pdf) can try to reduce a section further. Recommended and Strong may turn pages into images, so use Light if selectable text matters and always review the download. Supported encrypted documents must first be [unlocked with a known password](/unlock-pdf), and only when you are authorized to do so.

## Name and inspect the files before sending

Use names that describe the section, then check the actual contents. If the document is intended for another person, confirm that each output includes only the requested pages. Do not rely on a filename, ZIP download or success message as proof of the selection.
